summary.text: Jamescita Peshlakai is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Lloyd Johnson in a race with no incumbent.
She previously served in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2013 to 2015 and in the Arizona State Senate from 2017 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Peshlakai earned a B.S. in history from Northern Arizona University in 1997 and an M.A. in educational psychology from the university in 2004, according to Ballotpedia.

Her career experience includes owning Navajo Beauty Way, working as a Native American liaison with the U.S. Department of the Interior, serving as a veterans, youth and elders liaison with the Navajo Nation Office of the President and Vice-President, and working as policy director of the Arizona Foundation For Women.
Peshlakai won election to the Arizona House of Representatives in District 7 in 2012 and served from 2013 to 2015.
She assumed office in the Arizona State Senate, representing District 7, on January 9, 2017, and resigned in December 2021 to accept a job with the U.S. Department of the Interior.
During her 2021-2022 term she was assigned to the Senate Commerce Committee, the Senate Education and Transportation Committee and the Government Committee.
